detail.description: Fresh gas is accelerated through small entrance tubes, it enters the internal chamber at a certain angle, allowing it to become unstable and to follow the path of least resistance. As the baby inhales, fresh gas is directed towards the infant. As inspiration ends, the flow is flipped around and leaves the generator through the expiratory tube effectively creating active expiration. The expiratory tube also acts as a reservoir of fresh gas, therefore should the infant’s peak flow demand rise above the delivered flow, gas will be entrained from the expiratory tube, allowing the infants peak flow requirement to be satisfied. detail.description: rPAP TM Stabilisation. Skin-to-Skin. Success. Home rPAP TM Reimagined Closing the gap between international clinical guidelines and delivery room reality. The rPAP Re-imagined delivers a 12% absolute reduction in delivery room intubations [1], 92% lower Work of Breathing (WOB) [2], and a 2.4m reach for immediate family-centred care [3, 4], all by unleashing the potential of the infant warming infrastructure you already own. What is rPAP TM Reimagined? The rPAP Re-imagined is a hybrid respiratory device that seamlessly combines a premium nCPAP patient interface with the full capabilities of a delivery room resuscitator [3]. By incorporating a built-in resuscitation/PEEP valve port directly at the patient interface, it gives clinicians the unique ability to deliver manual backup inflation breaths instantly, using either nasal prongs or a standard face mask, without ever disrupting continuous, protective fluidic pressure [3]. The Why? 12% Reduction in Intubations Clinically proven to protect the transitional phase and deliver a 12% absolute reduction in delivery room intubation rates, keeping more infants stable at the mother’s side and avoiding unnecessary intensive care admissions [1]. 92% Lower Work of Breathing Powered by patented fluidic flip technology that actively assists expiration, dropping Imposed Work of Breathing (IWOB) by 92% compared to standard continuous-flow T-pieces to preserve the infant’s vital energy [2, 3]. 2.4-Metre Spatial Reach Engineered with a specialised 2.4-metre extended limb to close the physical gap in the delivery room, allowing clinicians to deliver gold-standard respiratory stabilisation directly on the mother’s chest or at the cord without maternal-infant separation [3, 4]. ILCOR Standard Alignment Fully aligned with international consensus guidelines by prioritising immediate, non-invasive nasal CPAP (nCPAP) support at birth over invasive intubation to protect fragile, developing neonatal lungs [5].
